id.description: Unique identifier for the test card, e.g. DGV-TC-001

svrnos_layer.description: The target SVRNOS governance layer this test card evaluates

ger_mapping.description: The canonical SVRNOS Governance Error Register (GER) code mapped to this claim's failure condition

replay_protection_required.description: If true, the system must demonstrate token replay resistance

latency_threshold_ms.description: Maximum allowed verification execution latency in milliseconds

claim_name.description: Descriptive name of the claim class being verified

claim_definition.description: Exact definition of what is being tested and certified

scope.description: Operational scope covered by this test card

excluded_scope.description: Scenarios explicitly excluded from the certification

test_type.description: The methodology used to evaluate outcomes

expected.description: Expected outputs, metrics, or validation thresholds

mandatory.description: If true, this case must pass to certify the claim

metrics.description: List of metrics evaluated by this test card

pass_threshold.description: Acceptable criteria/rules for metrics to declare a pass status

evidence.description: Evidence output path where run details will be written

enforcement_layer.description: Specifies how the governance rule is actively enforced

required_preconditions.description: State prerequisites required before test execution (e.g. fresh_snapshot)

threat_model_tie_in.description: Specific attack scenarios this card defends against

version.description: Semantic version of the test card

expiry.description: Timestamp or version constraint for validity
